headline: President Trump directs the Secretary of State to follow an "America First" approach in US foreign policy.
what_it_does: This executive order gives instructions to the Secretary of State, who leads the State Department and US diplomacy with other countries. Based on its title, it sets an "America First" policy direction for that work. No summary was provided, so the specific steps the order requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: The Secretary of State and State Department staff
who_it_affects.how: They are the direct audience of the order and are told to carry out its policy direction.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; no separate effective date was provided.
